consequence.statement: Environments configured with `experimental.ruler.enable-api` will have this setting ignored; the configuration must be migrated to `ruler.enable-api` to take effect.
consequence.remediation: Rename the configuration key from `experimental.ruler.enable-api` to `ruler.enable-api` in your Loki configuration.

assertion.statement: The experimental configuration key `experimental.ruler.enable-api` is removed in favour of the standard `ruler.enable-api` key.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for config-key renamed
